summary: Genmab A/S filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial report for the second quarter and half-year ended June 30, 2026. The filing presents IFRS-based financial statements, segment revenue by collaboration partners (J&J, Roche, Novartis, BioNTech, Pfizer), and product sales details for DARZALEX, Kesimpta, and Tepezza. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. The filing is a routine periodic report of operating results.
